shared_elements: relief carving in low relief on a stone surface
glyph-like or patterned motifs arranged in registers/bands
suggestion of a figural/anthropomorphic element within a carved panel
justification: Both surfaces bear low-relief carving organized in horizontal bands or panels, with A showing an eroded sequence of block-like glyphic units and possibly a figure, and B showing a large winged anthropomorphic figure flanked by vertical borders of repeated rosette-and-stem motifs. Beyond the generic fact of relief panels with repeated motif rows, nothing specific corresponds: B's dominant bearded winged figure with raised arm, bucket, tassels and feathered wing has no counterpart in A's compact rounded-cartouche glyph blocks.
